DeletePersonalPluginDescription: This plugin will no longer be available to you. Are you sure you want to continue?
DeletePluginDescription: This plugin will no longer be available to the workspace users. Are you sure you want to continue?
DeleteUserPluginDescription: The {{pluginName}} plugin will be deleted for {{userName}} together with its settings. It cannot be restored.
NoUsersPlugins: No one has added their own plugins yet
NoUsersPluginsDescription: When a user adds a plugin in their profile, it appears here. You can then turn it off or delete it.
PersonalPluginNotLoaded: Reload the page to use this plugin.
PersonalPluginsAdminDescription: Plugins you add here work only for you. Plugins for all workspace users are managed on the <1>Plugins</1> page of the settings.
PersonalPluginsDescription: Plugins you add here work only for you. Plugins for all workspace users are added by the administrator.
PersonalPluginShadowed: Not in use: {{pluginName}} {{version}} is installed for all workspace users by the administrator.
PersonalPluginShadowedDisabled: Not in use: {{pluginName}} is installed for all workspace users and turned off by the administrator.
PersonalPluginsSwitch: Let users add their own plugins
PersonalPluginsSwitchDescription: A user can upload a plugin on the Plugins tab of their profile, and it works only for them. If you turn this setting off, personal plugins stop working for everyone but are not deleted: once you turn it back on, they work again.
PluginBundleRequestFailed: The request for {{url}} failed with HTTP {{status}}
PluginCacheWarningDescription: Plugins are cached based on their version number. To ensure your changes are applied, please increment the version number in your <1>package.json</1> file before uploading. The system will not update a plugin if the version remains the same
PluginIsNotCompatible: The plugin SDK version doesn’t match the {{organizationName}} {{productName}} version. Please update to a compatible version.
PluginNoDefaultExport: The plugin module has no default export
PluginNotRegistered: The script ran but registered no plugin named "{{pluginName}}"
PluginSDKDescription: Use the Plugin SDK to add new functionality, connect third-party services, or improve the existing experience. Browse sample plugins below, with source code available on GitHub. Go to the <1>Plugins</1> page to enable them for your workspace.
PluginSDKInstruction: <1>Read instructions</1> to build your own plugins.
UploadDescription: Add plugins to extend your workspace with extra features. Enable one from the list below, or click "Upload plugin" (or drop a ZIP file) to add your own.
UsersPluginsDescription: Here are the plugins that users added just for themselves. Only the user who added a plugin sees its settings. If you turn a plugin off, its user can turn it back on. To remove a plugin for good, delete it.
